lines.text: The root is Graph! Telegraph, graph.
Did you know? Graph is Greek for write or draw.
Telegraph: far plus write or draw.
Quick quiz! Which means far plus write or draw?
Telegraph! Far plus write or draw.

words.ex: Do you know who invented the telegraph?
The graph shows sales over the last five years.
